label: Quantization
role: To discretise the continuous moduli space into a finite, balanced state‑space — the narrative Hilbert space.
definition: Quantization is geometric quantization of the complement’s character variety. The formula Q = 19ⁿ × 2ᵐ gives the dimension of the space of holomorphic sections of the prequantum line bundle over the resonance torus. The ternary balance requirement ((Q−1)/3, (Q−1)/3+1, (Q−1)/3) preserves the alternating knot’s ℤ₃ symmetry. In HoTT, this truncates the ∞‑groupoid to a finite n,m‑skeleton, giving a concrete type whose terms are all possible story configurations at that complexity. The combined capacity C = 19ⁿ × 2ᵐ is the total number of distinct state vectors the Factor can occupy.
manifestation: A Factor with n=1, m=3 has capacity 19¹×2³ = 152 distinct configurations. The system can enumerate them to verify consistency or suggest branching paths.
formula: Q = 19ⁿ, R = 2ᵐ; combined capacity = Q × R.
hott_view: Truncation of the knot complement’s fundamental ∞‑groupoid to a finite level, yielding a manageable type.
hamiltonian_view: Dimension of the Hilbert space obtained by geometric quantisation of the symplectic phase space.
